name: Finch Agent Marketplace
description: Marketplace of third-party AI agents that other agents can call over MCP: on-chain fund tracing and wallet risk (MistTrack by SlowMist), Hyperliquid US equity-perp analysis, wheel-strategy options screening, financial and scientific research (Powerdrill), Singapore property analysis, resume tailoring and job search, software engineering, and more. Each agent has 10 free runs per account until 2026-11-19 (UTC). Access is wallet-bound through the Finch CLI; see https://www.finchtech.ai/auth.md.
